data.one_liner: A Nextcloud API client written in Dart supporting maintained server versions.
data.what_it_does: Provides a comprehensive Nextcloud API client library for Dart and Flutter applications. It supports multiple authentication methods including HTTP Basic and Bearer auth (app passwords) and exposes endpoints grouped by Nextcloud apps.
use_when: You are building a Flutter or Dart application that interacts with a Nextcloud server.
You need standard access to Nextcloud APIs like files, notes, talk, and other supported apps.
avoid_when: You are not interacting with a Nextcloud server backend.
You need custom REST functionality completely outside the scope of Nextcloud server APIs.
strengths: Supports all maintained Nextcloud server versions and common apps.
Built-in support for multiple authentication methods including app passwords.
weaknesses: API endpoints are tied to specific Nextcloud server and app versions.
Not all endpoints are guaranteed to have full unit test coverage.
data.setup_notes: Flutter applications may require additional configuration for networking.

alternatives.name: dio
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need a general-purpose HTTP client for custom REST APIs instead of a dedicated Nextcloud client.

alternatives.name: http
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want a low-level, generic HTTP client to perform manual requests.
